correctness.rationale: For a one-positive normal \(a=(x,-y_2,\ldots,-y_n)\), conditioning the exponential representation gives the exact density \(x^{-1}\prod_j(1+y_j/x)^{-1}\). With \(r_j=y_j/x\) and \(\sum r_j=1\), AM--GM yields the claimed ratio and its sharp equality condition; the normalization identity gives the equivalent angular form. Along a unit-speed spherical geodesic through the facet normal, differentiating the exact logarithmic formula gives zero first derivative and constant second derivative \((2n-1)/n\) in every tangent direction, hence the stated Hessian.
residual_risks: No correctness defect was found; the scientific rejection is due to mechanical prior implication and value, not access failure.

final_claim: In the one-positive-coordinate chamber for central sections of a regular simplex, the section-volume ratio satisfies the displayed \(\sec\theta\) lower bound with equality only at the facet-parallel normal, and the Riemannian Hessian at that minimizer is isotropic with eigenvalue \(((2n-1)/n)V_{\min}\).
